title: bug: get_context's WORKING nextAction sends a worker to refused or superseded calls: moe.start_step for a step already IN_PROGRESS (refused INVALID_STATE, so every mid-step resume opens on a refusal), moe.complete_task on a plan-less WORKING row (refused NOT_ALLOWED), and an amended step's original text instead of its amendment
description:
Filed by defect hunt #16 (task-151a2c54, architect-2a219562) on 2026-11-04. Found by the lane-1 subagent; the holder re-ran all three repros and re-read the cited lines at b9205914. One row: all three defects sit in the same 25-line WORKING branch of one function.

CONTRACT
- docs/roles/worker.md:23: "Follow `nextAction` on every Moe tool response."
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md `### moe.get_context` (:180-336 at b9205914) never states the WORKING hint rule. This row adds it.

PROBLEM (packages/moe-daemon/src/util/contextNextAction.ts:29-55, the WORKING branch)
1. IN_PROGRESS step.
   - :30 picks the first step that is PENDING or IN_PROGRESS, and :37-41 always answers `moe.start_step`.
   - tools/startStep.ts:51-52 refuses any step that is not PENDING: `invalidState('Step', status, 'PENDING')`.
   - complete_step already handles the same case. tools/completeStep.ts:192-198 says "start_step would reject it (PENDING-only). Point the worker at completing it" and answers `moe.complete_step`.
   - Exposure: every relaunched session on its own row after a mid-step crash or timeout. The wrapper's RESUME path keeps the step IN_PROGRESS, so the new session's first hint is refused. Any mid-step re-read (for example after a compaction) hits it too.
2. Plan-less WORKING row.
   - An empty plan never matches a remaining step, so :48-52 answers `moe.complete_task` "All steps complete; hand task off to QA."
   - util/enforcement.ts:256-261 refuses an empty plan NOT_ALLOWED ("it has no implementation plan"), and startStep.ts:43-44 refuses it too.
   - setTaskStatus.ts allows BACKLOG → WORKING, and the claim does not check for a plan. Uncommon, but such a worker gets no route to a plan.
3. Amended step.
   - :41 quotes `nextStep.description`. util/planAmendments.ts:36-42 says effectiveStepDescription is "the ONE resolution point — tools must not re-derive it".
   - After moe.amend_plan_step, the hint therefore tells the worker to begin the REPLACED instructions.
   - This is the daemon twin of the DONE client fixes 37e03b91 (JetBrains), e9a25fbf (VS Code) and c5c092ae (compaction keeper).

EVIDENCE
Repros are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-151a2c54/A/, each with a .output.txt. In a git archive of b9205914, run `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/<file>`; each fails:
- zzHuntA_inProgressHint.test.ts: expected "moe.complete_step", received "moe.start_step". Following the hint gives "[INVALID_STATE] Step is in IN_PROGRESS state, expected PENDING".
- zzHuntA_planlessWorking.test.ts: the hint is moe.complete_task, and following it gives "[NOT_ALLOWED] Cannot complete task task-1: it has no implementation plan…".
- zzHuntA_amendedStepHint.test.ts: expected "Begin step: Keep the cache module; only add a TTL option", received "Begin step: Delete the legacy cache module".

FIX DIRECTION
- An IN_PROGRESS step answers `moe.complete_step` with "Finish in-progress step …", exactly as completeStep.ts:192-198 does.
- An empty plan answers a call the daemon accepts on that row (`moe.request_replan` accepts WORKING), or no tool.
- Every step reason quotes effectiveStepDescription(nextStep).
- Add one bullet stating this rule to `### moe.get_context`, and edit nothing else in docs/MCP_SERVER.md.

FILES
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/contextNextAction.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getContext.test.ts (or a new util/contextNextAction.test.ts)
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md (### moe.get_context only)
Nothing here is held by an open row at 06:01Z.
definitionOfDone: For a WORKING row whose first unfinished step is IN_PROGRESS, get_context's nextAction is moe.complete_step for that stepId, and calling it as hinted is accepted. A vitest case built from the hunt repro zzHuntA_inProgressHint proves it.

A plan-less WORKING row is never hinted moe.complete_task, and any hinted call is not refused. Every start_step or complete_step hint quotes effectiveStepDescription, so an amended step shows its replacement text. Vitest cases built from zzHuntA_planlessWorking and zzHuntA_amendedStepHint prove both.
The existing getContext tests pass. The `### moe.get_context` section states the WORKING hint rule, and no other section of docs/MCP_SERVER.md changes.

implementationPlan.description:
Tests first (red). Create packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getContextWorkingHint.test.ts from the three hunt-16 repros, copied to /mnt/d/moe-scratch/f0ca0ff0-plan/zzHuntA_*.test.ts. Use the same ToolTestHarness setup and the `call(name, args)` helper over getTools(h.state). Do not commit the zzHuntA file names.
Every case reads the hint through moe.get_context, then follows it VERBATIM with call(hint.tool, hint.args), and asserts exact values.
(1) After start_step(step-1) on a 2-step plan, the hint is tool 'moe.complete_step', args { taskId:'task-1', stepId:'step-1', workerId:'worker-1' }, and its reason starts 'Finish in-progress step step-1: First step'. Following it does not throw, and step-1 becomes COMPLETED.
(2) An IN_PROGRESS LAST step carries recommendedSkill equal to recommendSkillFor('worker','final_step'): compare with the call, not a literal. With reopenCount 1, the 'reopened' skill wins.
(3) A plan-less row moved BACKLOG -> WORKING by set_task_status with no workerId, then claimed by worker-1, is hinted 'moe.request_replan', never 'moe.complete_task', with a non-empty args.reason. Following it succeeds and the row becomes PLANNING.
(4) After amend_plan_step by 'architect-1', a PENDING step's reason === 'Begin step: Keep the cache module; only add a TTL option'. An amended IN_PROGRESS step's complete_step reason contains the amended text and not the original.
(5) Regression: a fresh PENDING plan still gets 'moe.start_step', 'Begin step: First step' and the first_start_step skill. An all-COMPLETED plan still gets 'moe.complete_task'.
Run the file in your snapshot (the step-4 recipe) and record the red result in complete_step's note: cases 1-4 fail before step 2, and case 5 passes. Write this file with your own Edit/Write tool (global rail 3).

Failing: IN_PROGRESS hint (start_step vs complete_step), final_step skill, reopened skill, plan-less (complete_task vs request_replan), amended PENDING reason (original text quoted), amended IN_PROGRESS. Passing: out-of-order guard, fresh PENDING, later PENDING, all-COMPLETED. Other 4 files green (106 total pass). Setup note: start_step needs contextFetchedBy, seeded in the helper.

implementationPlan.description:
The fix (green). In packages/moe-daemon/src/util/contextNextAction.ts, rewrite ONLY the `if (task.status === 'WORKING')` branch (:29-55 at b9205914). The governor, PLANNING and REVIEW branches stay byte-identical, including e44fbbf3's needsHumanReview guard. A proven prototype is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/f0ca0ff0-plan/proto-contextNextAction.diff: with it the hunt repros and 4 existing files pass and tsc is clean. Apply it with your own Edit tool, never patch or cp.
Rules:
(a) An empty plan answers { tool:'moe.request_replan', args:{ taskId, workerId: workerId || undefined, reason:'This WORKING task has no implementation plan; an architect must plan it before any step can start.' }, reason:'No implementation plan: request a plan instead of starting or completing work.' } with no recommendedSkill. It is callable verbatim: request_replan requires only taskId and reason (requestReplan.ts:32), accepts WORKING (:55) and checks the assignee (:60).
(b) If the first unfinished step (`find` PENDING or IN_PROGRESS, in plan order, as completeStep.ts does) is IN_PROGRESS, answer { tool:'moe.complete_step', args:{ taskId, stepId, workerId: workerId || undefined }, reason:`Finish in-progress step ${stepId}: ${desc}` }. Its recommendedSkill is reopenedSkill, else recommendSkillFor('worker','final_step') on the last step, else undefined. This mirrors completeStep.ts:194-201.
(c) A PENDING step keeps today's start_step hint and skills, with reason 'Begin step: ' + desc.
(d) desc = effectiveStepDescription(nextStep).slice(0, 80), imported from './planAmendments.js' (types-only imports, so no cycle). It never throws and falls back to the original text.
(e) A non-empty plan with no step left keeps today's complete_task hint.
The function is pure, with no IO, so nothing new to catch. Keep `workerId || undefined` so a workerId-less read still omits the key.
implementationPlan.note: WORKING branch rewritten (plan-less → request_replan; IN_PROGRESS → complete_step with final_step/reopened skill; PENDING keeps start_step; all hints quote effectiveStepDescription sliced to 80). Governor/PLANNING/REVIEW branches untouched. Gate in snapshot: tsc clean, 5 files / 112 tests pass (was 6 red).
One paragraph ("WORKING nextAction", 4 bullets + effective-text sentence) inserted in ### moe.get_context between the contextFetchedBy paragraph and **Returns:**. No other hunk in the file.

Fresh checkRef run (gate.sh checksum OK): exit 0, tsc --noEmit clean, 5 test files / 112 tests passed (getContextWorkingHint, getContext 55, getContextGovernance 15, accountTools 19, recommendSkill 13). git status: exactly docs/MCP_SERVER.md, contextNextAction.ts, new getContextWorkingHint.test.ts.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
get_context's nextAction on a WORKING task names a call the daemon accepts, for the assignee.
- A plan-less row gets moe.request_replan with a ready reason.
- A row whose first unfinished step is IN_PROGRESS gets moe.complete_step for that step, the rule complete_step's own hint already applies.
- A PENDING step keeps moe.start_step.
- A finished plan keeps moe.complete_task.
Every step hint quotes the step's effective (amended) text. The `### moe.get_context` doc states the rule.
acceptanceCriteria: After start_step, a get_context re-read hints moe.complete_step { taskId, stepId, workerId } for the IN_PROGRESS step, and calling it verbatim succeeds.
A plan-less WORKING row is hinted moe.request_replan with a non-empty args.reason, never moe.complete_task. Calling it verbatim moves the row to PLANNING.
After moe.amend_plan_step, the start_step and complete_step hint reasons quote the amendment, not the original text.
PENDING and all-COMPLETED plans keep today's start_step and complete_task hints and skills. Existing getContext, getContextGovernance, accountTools and recommendSkill tests pass unchanged.
invariants: contextNextAction stays a pure function of (state, task, workerId), with no IO and no writes.
Only the WORKING branch changes. getContext.ts, the only caller (:428), is not edited.
The diff is exactly contextNextAction.ts, the new test file and the one MCP_SERVER.md paragraph.
compatibility: The nextAction shape { tool, args, reason, recommendedSkill? } is unchanged, and nextAction is advisory, so no MCP tool contract changes.
The PENDING start_step hint (reason 'Begin step: …', first_start_step or implementation_step skill, reopened precedence) and the complete_task hint keep their exact current values.
The governor chat_wait hint, the PLANNING submit_plan hint and the REVIEW qa_approve hint, with its needsHumanReview guard, are untouched.
approvedScope: docs/MCP_SERVER.md: one new paragraph inside `### moe.get_context`, between the contextFetchedBy paragraph and **Returns:**.
reuse: effectiveStepDescription (util/planAmendments.ts:36-42), the single resolution point for step text.
complete_step's own IN_PROGRESS rule (tools/completeStep.ts:194-201), mirrored, not re-invented.

tools/startStep.ts:43-44 refuses an empty plan and :51-52 refuses a non-PENDING step (invalidState).
util/enforcement.ts:256-261 refuses complete_task on an empty plan (NOT_ALLOWED).
tools/requestReplan.ts:32 requires taskId and reason, :55 accepts only WORKING, and :60 checks assertWorkerOwns.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: For a plan-less row: (a) moe.request_replan with a ready reason: callable verbatim and routes the row to an architect. (b) Return no hint at all: safe, but leaves the worker with no route. Chose (a). For an IN_PROGRESS step: complete_step (mirrors completeStep.ts) rather than a re-start. start_step is PENDING-only by design, and the in-progress lease belongs to this assignee.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: contextNextAction has one caller (getContext.ts:428). Existing hint tests: getContextGovernance.test.ts:84-99 ('retains $tool guidance', PENDING → start_step, all COMPLETED → complete_task) and accountTools.test.ts:171 (start_step). The tool-level test harness is ToolTestHarness plus getTools(h.state), as in the hunt repros. amend_plan_step works for an id with the architect- prefix (role resolves from the id).
planningNotes.risks:
- Don't touch the REVIEW branch's needsHumanReview guard (e44fbbf3).
- The new paragraph must stay inside `### moe.get_context`. Several open rows edit other sections of MCP_SERVER.md, and worktree-mode merge-tree lands distinct hunks cleanly.
- Scratch-clone hygiene: the architect's own prototype run once had a failed `cd` fall through into a relative `cp` in the shared checkout. It was restored at once, but it is the reason step 4 says use absolute paths and `set -e`.
- The gate's npm ci needs network access or a warm cache (about 15-40 s).
